results.message: Hi po! Magkano po yung ube cheese pandesal? Pwede po ba ipadeliver bukas sa Cubao?
results.expect: ₱180 for 6 / ₱340 for 12; next-day ok if ordered before 6 PM today; Lalamove/Grab, buyer pays fee; asks for order details.

reply.reply: Hello po! Ang ube cheese pandesal po namin ay ₱180 for box of 6 at ₱340 for box of 12. Pwede po ipadeliver bukas sa Cubao via Lalamove or Grab (buyer shoulders the fee) basta makahabol po sa 6 PM cut-off today! Send lang po your name, address, contact number, and order details para ma-process po natin. 😊
factsUsed: Ube cheese pandesal: box of 6 = ₱180, box of 12 = ₱340

Delivery via Lalamove or Grab, buyer pays the delivery fee
Send name, address, contact number, order and delivery date

factsUsed: Leche flan must be refrigerated, up to 4 days.
